candidates.failure_scenario: installInheritedCur is handed `fr` and then calls harnessSeedsCur, which assumes `fr` is m.PeekCallFrame(1) so that PeekCallFrame(2) is the caller. That holds today only because both call sites pass the top call frame (op_call.go:404 passes doOpCall's `fr = m.LastFrame()`, op_call.go:841 passes m.LastFrame() after PushFrameCall). A third caller, or a caller that installs into a frame that is not the top one, silently reads a different frame and exempts the wrong call — in the function whose own header says it exists so two paths "cannot drift apart again". Passing the caller frame in (`harnessSeedsCur(m.PeekCallFrame(2))`) puts the index next to `fr`, where the assumption is visible.
